headline: Iraq PM sacks nine officials over oil smuggling in pro-Iran stronghold  - Grenada Chronicle – Daily Grenada And Caribbean News
summary: Iraq's Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi dismissed nine senior security officials over an alleged oil smuggling operation in the Jurf al-Nasr area. The area is described as a pro-Iran stronghold.
why: Iraq is a major crude oil exporter, and smuggling diverts government revenue and complicates control of oil flows.
